label: Has been inside the TARDIS
description: Physical entry within the loaded TV era; seeing it from outside does not count.

label: Has met the Daleks
description: Direct interaction, attack or live communication; simply sharing an episode does not count.

label: Has had their body changed
description: A physical transformation, regeneration, implant or explicit bodily alteration; ordinary injury does not count. Devices that cloak identity such as perception filters do not count.

label: Uses a disguise or false identity
description: An impersonation, invented identity or concealed allegiance used to deceive another character.

label: Gives orders or runs an organisation
description: Directs staff, followers, troops or a coordinated operation on screen.

label: Is captured, restrained or imprisoned
description: Physically detained or locked in against their will; ordinary confinement at work does not count.

label: Is a parent
description: Parenthood established within the loaded TV era, including the Doctor's reference to having been a dad.

label: Is a non-human alien
description: Alien life, including Time Lords; excludes humans, human-made robots and terrestrial animals.

label: Is a companion
description: Travels with the Doctor as a companion within the loaded TV era. The Doctor himself does not count.

label: Has met the Slitheen
description: Direct interaction, an attack or a live conversation within the loaded TV era. Sharing an episode or being that enemy does not count.

label: Has met the Autons
description: Direct interaction, an attack or a live conversation within the loaded TV era. Sharing an episode or being that enemy does not count.

label: Has met the Gelth
description: Direct interaction, an attack or a live conversation within the loaded TV era. Sharing an episode or being that enemy does not count.

label: Has met the Reapers
description: Direct interaction, an attack or a live conversation within the loaded TV era. Sharing an episode or being that enemy does not count.

label: Has met the Empty Child
description: Direct interaction, an attack or a live conversation within the loaded TV era. Sharing an episode or being that enemy does not count.

label: Is human
description: Human characters, including humans with surgical or technological alterations. Excludes Time Lords and artificial duplicates.

label: Has met the Cybermen
description: Direct interaction, an attack or live communication within the loaded TV era. Sharing an episode or being that enemy does not count.

label: Has met the Weeping Angels
description: Direct interaction, an attack or live communication within the loaded TV era. Sharing an episode or being that enemy does not count.

label: Has met the Sontarans
description: Direct interaction, an attack or live communication within the loaded TV era. Sharing an episode or being that enemy does not count.

label: Has met the Judoon
description: Direct interaction, an attack or live communication within the loaded TV era. Sharing an episode or being that enemy does not count.

label: Has travelled through time
description: A journey to a different time, not simply being alive in a historical or future setting.

label: Has visited a parallel universe
description: Physically crosses into a parallel universe, rather than merely seeing or hearing about it.

label: Has died
description: The character is shown or explicitly confirmed to have died. Includes deaths later reversed or erased by changes to the timeline, and fatal injuries that force a Time Lord to regenerate. Apparent deaths, mistaken reports and voluntary regenerations do not count. A parallel-universe counterpart’s death applies only to that counterpart. Destruction or deactivation of wholly artificial beings does not count - cybernetically modified living beings such as cyborgs do count.

label: Is a robot/android
description: An artificially created, non-biological being, whether autonomous or controlled by another entity. Includes robots, androids and animated constructs such as Autons. Excludes biological beings enhanced or enclosed by technology, such as Cybermen and Daleks, as well as ordinary machinery and vehicles.

label: Has travelled through space
description: Has been transported between locations by teleportation, a portal, a wormhole or the TARDIS dematerialising and rematerialising. Includes travel within the same planet. Excludes conventional journeys by spacecraft or other vehicles, and simply entering or standing inside the TARDIS.
